name: API contract change
description: Design and verify one API boundary with explicit request, response, error, compatibility, and observability behavior.

outcomes.description: The API contract documents success, validation, failure, timeout, and compatibility behavior.
The implementation and deterministic checks agree on the declared boundary without live secrets.

prerequisites.description: The caller, expected data shape, compatibility window, and error semantics are known.
prerequisites.check: List request and response cases before editing the handler.

prerequisites.description: The contract can be exercised with local fixtures or a non-sensitive preview.
prerequisites.check: Confirm no live customer data or credential value is needed.

lanes.objective: Describe request, success, error, timeout, and compatibility cases for the boundary.
Implement the agreed API behavior and safe validation without unrelated endpoints.
Run deterministic success, validation, error, timeout, and compatibility checks.

qualityGates.description: Every declared request and response case has a deterministic fixture or reasoned exception.
Existing callers retain compatible behavior or the change records a clear migration path.
Errors and metrics are useful while payloads and credentials remain redacted.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response for an API check.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; use local fixtures or a safe session instead.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Send a live request that mutates data, billing, account security, or financial execution.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Contract work can be verified without live mutation.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the previous contract fixture set and return to the last known-good integration point if compatibility is uncertain.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted request and response shapes.
Preserve the implementation and fixture changes separately.
Record the first unresolved case and abandon rather than guessing.
stopConditions: A fixture needs real customer or secret data.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit tokens, authorization headers, private paths, and payload secrets.
Record status classes and field names without sensitive values.
